question: Which of the following is the full form of EBCDIC?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Extended Binary-Coded-Decimal Interchange Code.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• EBCDIC which stands for the Extended Binary Coded Decimal Interchange Code, is an 8-bit character encoding used on IBM mainframes and AS/400s.
 
• This encoding was developed in **1963 and 1964.**
 
• This is a coding system used to represent characters-letters, numerals, punctuation marks, and other symbols in computerized text. A character is represented in EBCDIC by eight-bit.
 
• EBCDIC can code up to **256 different characters.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Some important abbreviations used in Computer:

 
 
• BIOS - Basic Input Output System
 
• CAD - Computer-Aided Design
 
• EDVAC - Electronic Discrete Variable Automatic Computer
 
• EPROM - Erasable Programmable Read-Only Memory
 
• FORTRAN - FORmula TRANslation
 
• GPRS - General Packet Radio Service
